changeSet.author: sDooley
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Class] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_Class] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [DisplayFormat] [nvarchar](250) CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_DisplayFormat] DEFAULT ('{ID}') NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Hierarchical] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_Hierarchical] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [HierarchyPredicateID] [int] NULL, [HierarchyIntersectTypeID] [int] NULL, [HierarchyMaximumDepth] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_HierarchyMaximumDepth] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_ObjectId] DEFAULT (NEXT VALUE FOR [dbo].[AssetType_ObjectID_Seq]) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [Notes] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [CanOwnFusion] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_assetType_CanOwnFusion] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [AutoDisplayDescription] [bit] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UseAsTransformation] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetType_UseAsTransformation] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [HashValue] [binary](20) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [AssetType_Object_ObjectId] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetType_Object_ObjectID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetType_Object_ObjectID_Include] ON [dbo].[AssetType] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID]) END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[AssetType]','FlowObjectType') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetType] ADD [FlowObjectType] int END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[AssetType]','CanEditParent') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetType] ADD [CanEditParent] bit END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [dbo].[AssetType] WHERE Name = 'MetricAllocation' AND Class = 16) BEGIN insert into [dbo].[AssetType]([Name] ,[Description] ,[Class] ,[DisplayFormat] ,[State] ,[Hierarchical] ,[HierarchyPredicateID] ,[HierarchyIntersectTypeID] ,[HierarchyMaximumDepth] ,[Object] ,[ObjectID] ,[CreatedOn] ,[CreatedBy] ,[UpdatedOn] ,[UpdatedBy] ,[Notes] ,[uid] ,[CanOwnFusion] ,[AutoDisplayDescription] ,[UseAsTransformation] ,[FlowObjectType] ,[CanEditParent] ,[AutoDisplayParent]) values('MetricAllocation','A Metric Allocation',16,'{Name}',1,0,NULL,NULL,0,'MetricAllocation',1,GETDATE(),0,GETDATE(),0,NULL,'00000001-0000-0000-0000-B00000000013',0,0,0,NULL,1,NULL) END
changeSet.rollback:
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[AssetType]','CanEditParent') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetType] DROP COLUMN [CanEditParent] END
Delete from [dbo].[AssetType] where Name = 'MetricAllocation' AND Class = 16

changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetType_Uid_ObjectID') BEGIN DROP INDEX IX_AssetType_Uid_ObjectID ON [dbo].[AssetType] END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[AssetType] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', [Object], ObjectID, coalesce(CreatedBy, 0)), [Object], ObjectID from inserted where [Object] != 'FusionAttributeType';

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetType_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[AssetType] AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Update', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', [Object], ObjectID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), [Object], ObjectID from inserted where [Object] != 'FusionAttributeType';
